name: BL-1020
summary: BL-1020 (perphenazine 4-aminobutanoate) is an investigational orally-active antipsychotic for the possible treatment of schizophrenia. The chemical is an ester of GABA and perphenazine; pharmacologically it acts as a D2 antagonist and GABA agonist. It has shown pro-cognitive effects in the trials. In March 2013, it went into the II/III trial phase.

pharmacology.text: The chemical is an ester of GABA and perphenazine; pharmacologically it acts as a D2 antagonist and GABA agonist.

uses.text: BL-1020 (perphenazine 4-aminobutanoate) is an investigational orally-active antipsychotic for the possible treatment of schizophrenia.

sideEffects.en: Because it releases perphenazine, its effects are those of an older antipsychotic: stiffness, tremor, restlessness and sedation. It did not succeed in trials and was not marketed.
sideEffects.zh: 由於它會釋出 perphenazine，其反應就是舊型抗精神病藥的反應：肌肉僵硬、顫抖、坐立不安與鎮靜。它在試驗中未能成功，也未上市。
sideEffects.zhHans: 由于它会发布 perphenazine，其反应就是旧型抗精神病药的反应：肌肉僵硬、颤抖、坐立不安与镇静。它在试验中未能成功，也未上市。

fact.en: It is two drugs tied together: perphenazine, an antipsychotic, joined by an ester bridge to GABA, the brain's main calming transmitter. The bridge is meant to break once inside the brain.
fact.zh: 它是把兩種藥物綁在一起的產物：抗精神病藥 perphenazine 以酯鍵連接到大腦主要的抑制性傳訊物質 GABA。這道連結設計上會在進入大腦後斷開。
fact.zhHans: 它是把两种药物绑在一起的产物：抗精神病药 perphenazine 以酯键连接到大脑主要的抑制性传讯物质 GABA。这道链接设计上会在进入大脑后断开。
